svg.title: Energy distance: two groups in a room
svg.desc: Two point-cloud panels compare the average cross-group distance with the average within-group distance. When group A and group B are the same crowd, cross and within distances are similar and the energy distance is near zero. When the groups are different populations sitting apart, the cross distance is much larger than either within distance and the energy distance is large.
